completion_data.completion_summary: Dispatch 36 landed sub-phases 16.2a and 16.2b of Phase 16 in three green sub-steps. It settled the indexing mismatch dispatch 34 flagged by re-indexing the one-period transfer operators to the combined periods -- forced, because the fold TailStable exists to certify moves by G.NB and not by G.nb -- then defined liveAt, L0, R0 and TailStable with a synthesized Decidable instance, and proved the plan's linchpin tailStable_iff_window in BOTH directions at every time down either periodic tail. The reverse direction needed a genuine construction rather than a shift argument, since no shift of a LabRun is a LabRun: runOfPos builds a run from any family of positions stepping along succP, and the three regions are a shifted reference run, the Phi-chain an iterate witnesses, and the chain endpoint's own reference run. Sub-phase 16.2c (exists_tailStable_repr plus the fixture's re-presentation) remains and is handed off precisely.
